id: \bMy Pokémon has a Bold Nature. It has a higher Defense stat than my other Pokémon.
en: \bMy Pokémon has a Bold Nature. It has a higher Defense stat than my other Pokémon.
it: \bIl mio Pokémon ha Natura Sicura. Ha una Difesa più alta degli altri miei Pokémon.

id: \bMaybe Nature has something to do with how stats grow?
en: \bMaybe Nature has something to do with how stats grow?
it: \bForse la natura c'entra qualcosa con la crescita delle statistiche?

id: \bWant some advice? Catch as many Pokémon as you can. Numbers will carry you to victory.
en: \bWant some advice? Catch as many Pokémon as you can. Numbers will carry you to victory.
it: \bVuoi un consiglio? Cattura più Pokémon che puoi. Sono i numeri a portarti alla vittoria.

id: \bYou're a Trainer. This might help you out then.
en: \bYou're a Trainer. This might help you out then.
it: \bSei un Allenatore. Allora questo potrebbe esserti utile.

id: \bYou can't just throw them. Weaken it in battle first.
en: \bYou can't just throw them. Weaken it in battle first.
it: \bNon puoi limitarti a lanciarle. Prima indebolisci il Pokémon in lotta.

id: \rI've told my husband so many times before. Numbers are good but trust and individual training is better.
en: \rI've told my husband so many times before.  Numbers are good but trust and individual training is better.
it: \rL'ho detto mille volte a mio marito.  I numeri vanno bene, ma la fiducia e l'allenamento individuale sono meglio.
